item.title: Wall, TLCA Joining Hill Country Teams Tops UIL Realignment Surprises

item.title: Mutton Bustin' Registration Opens for 2026 San Angelo Rodeo
item.description: SAN ANGELO, TX — Online registration opened Monday for the Sonora Bank Mutton Bustin’ competition at the 2026 San Angelo Stock Show and Rodeo. Entries are accepted online only at sanangelorodeo.com. A drawing to select participants will be held the evening of Feb. 19, with the results pre-recorded and posted on the San Angelo Stock Show and Rodeo Facebook page, SASSRA website, YouTube/SASSRA channel, and Sonora Bank Facebook page. Learn More Here.

item.title: LIVE! Daily News | Two Clyde Students Involved in Train Crash Pass Away
item.description: Today on LIVE!, James Bouligny and Tessa Koskovich discuss the news from today, including two Clyde ISD students who were killed in a crash with a train. item.title: UPDATE: DPS Details Clyde Train Crash That Killed Siblings; GoFundMe Started
item.description: CLYDE, TX — The Texas Department of Public Safety has released new details in the fatal train-truck collision that killed a Clyde High School student and his sister on Sunday.The DPS report identified the passenger as Brileigh Janae Dailey, 19, of Baird, and confirmed the vehicle became engulfed in flames after the impact. The driver, a 16-year-old male juvenile from Baird, was also killed in the crash, which occurred around 2:45 p.m. on Feb. 1, 2026. Learn More Here.
